raw_segments.text: Mean, While the South Wind Rose, And With Black Wings Wide-hovering, All the Clouds
Together Drove From Under Heaven, The Hills To Their Supply Vapor, And Exhalation,
Dusk And Moist, Sent Up Ammon, And Now The Thickened Sky Like A Dark Ceiling
Stood, Down Rush The Rain Impetuous, And Continued, Till The Earth No More Was
Seen, The Floating Vessel Swam Uplifted, And Secure
With Beaked Prow Road Tilting O'er The Waves, All Dwellings Else Flood Overwhelmed,
And Them With All Their Pump Deep Under Water Rolled,
See Covered Sea, Sea Without Shore, And In Their Palaces Where Luxury Late Rained,
See Monsters Welped And Stabled, Of Mankind So Numerous Late All Left In One Small Bottom
Swam Embarked.
